name: [🥷UPDATE] Anime Rising
desc:
Defeat. Arise. Conquer.
Resurrect your enemies as loyal summons and fight your way through challenging worlds and brutal trials. Only the strong can command the fallen.

Anime Rising is a strategy-based collector game where every fight counts.
💀 Turn enemies into allies
⚔️ Build your ultimate squad
🌍 Progress through harder stages and deadly bosses
🧠 Think fast. Play smart. Rise above.
